pages.title: Light Switch Game
pages.text: the Light Switch Game, using the levers find the correct combination to turn all the lights on the opposite side to their lit state.

pages.title: Digital Panel
pages.text: The Digital Panel is used to start the Light Switch Game. Interact with the block to start and the NPC with it to finish.

pages.title: Holoscreen
pages.text: A Holoscreen is given for succesfully completing the game.
